# Turquaz

> Turquaz is a Turkish and Mediterranean restaurant, bakery and coffee destination at 1198 Mission Street in San Francisco, California.

Turquaz serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, including Turkish breakfast, meze, soups, salads, bowls, kebabs, pide, bakery items, desserts, Turkish tea and coffee. Current selections and prices are published on the official menu. The restaurant accepts online reservations for parties up to 15 guests and provides online ordering and catering options.
